name: SSID_FILTER_OFF
description: Keep BSSes without an SSID element (e.g. an NDS beacon) in the scan results. The original firmware drops them in two places; both checks become nops.

changes.comment: FUN_c0000880 (adds a BSS to the scan table): beq drop when find_ie(SSID) == NULL -> nop
FUN_c0001aa8: bne 'first IE is not SSID -> return 0' -> nop (a DS beacon starts with Supported Rates)
